name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add one high-contrast skip link at the very top of every page that jumps straight to the main content. This fixes the biggest keyboard navigation pain point—users who rely on assistive tech can skip repetitive headers and nav blocks instantly. The trade-off is a single extra element at the top of each page, which is negligible compared to the universal accessibility gain.

name: Reader
text: A single high-contrast skip link fails users who rely on screen readers when the page reloads or dynamically updates—focus never reaches `<main>`, trapping them in a loop. Instead, pair it with `role="main"` *and* a visible skip link that persists after dynamic content changes; test with VoiceOver and NVDA to confirm focus shifts correctly. Settle it by running a 5-minute screen-reader test on a live page with dynamic updates.
